ADD_PRODUCT_READ_MANUAL: Please read the installation manual before proceeding with the installation
LOCATION_NEEDED: We need to activate high-accuracy position location to enable the search for networks and therefore add new objects or give a new network to objects already listed.
LOCATION_ACTIVATE: You must enable location services in order to identify your WiFi network
LOCATION_NOT_READY: Location services are not responding, wait a moment and try again
WIFI_IOS:
You are about to connect the product to the same WIFI(router) network as that to which your iPhone is connected.
To do this, please enter the password of your WIFI router.

If you want to connect the product to another WIFI (router) network, close the application and connect your iPhone to this other WIFI (router) network first.
Open the application again and restart the ‘add product’ procedure.

Notes:

- Your iPhone must be connected to your home WIFI network (your router). You cannot connect the product if the iPhone is connected in 4G mode

- The WiFi network must be in 2.4Ghz mode. You may have to adjust your router to put your WiFi in 2.4Ghz mode.
WIFI_GENERIC:
You are about to connect the product to the same WIFI(router) network as that to which your {{smartphone}} is connected.
To do this, please enter the password of your WIFI router.

If you want to connect the product to another WIFI (router) network, close the application and connect your {{smartphone}} to this other WIFI (router) network first.
Open the application again and restart the ‘add product’ procedure.

Notes:

- Your {{smartphone}} must be connected to your home WIFI network (your router). You cannot connect the product if your {{smartphone}} is connected in 4G mode

- The WiFi network must be in 2.4Ghz mode. You may have to adjust your router to put your WiFi in 2.4Ghz mode.
WIFI_IOS_CURRENT_SSID: Your iPhone is connected to the network {{network}}
WIFI_GENERIC_CURRENT_SSID: Your {{smartphone}} is connected to the network {{network}}
WIFI_NO_SSID_ALERT_BODY: The WiFi of your smartphone does not appear to be activated.
SMARTCONFIG_RUNNING:
Connecting.
This may take a few minutes
SMARTCONFIG_EXPLANATION: Connection is a 2-stage process: the control panel appears on screen and, a few seconds later, the product indicates that it is connected. (please refer to the product instructions).
SMARTCONFIG_NO_DEVICE_FOUND: No device found during pairing process
SMARTCONFIG_ERROR_ADDR_IN_USE:
A process is not available; it may already be active, or necessary resources may be used by another application.
Close all open applications and click on the $t(addProduct:START_AGAIN) button.
DEVICE_NAME_TOO_SHORT: The Name of the new object is too short
DEVICE_NAME_ALREADY_IN_USE: Another object already has this name, please enter a different name
NO_DEVICES_FOUND: No device found during the pairing process. Check the password provided and/or the position of the object in relation to the WiFi router.
DEVICE_RECONNECTED_TO_WIFI: The "{{infos}}" object reconnected using the network you provided during pairing.
DEVICE_RECONNECTED_TO_WIFI_plural: The "{{infos}}" objects reconnected using the network you provided during pairing.
DEVICE_ALSO_FOUND: One "{{infos}}" object was paired during the search.
DEVICE_ALSO_FOUND_plural: Objects were paired during the search:
REGISTER_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: You will save the last device
REGISTER_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION_plural: You will save the first device on the list
NO_WIFI: Connection to Wifi network lost; reconnect to the wifi network selected and press RESTART
CURRENT_SSID_UNKNOWN: No WIFI network activated on this device
DEVICE_NAME_DESCRIPTION:
Choose the name of your device carefully to make it easier to identify.
This can be helpful when several devices are connected.
e.g.: Small living room lamp
YOUR_DEVICE_IS_REGISTRED_ON_SERVER: Your device has been registered; it will be available shortly
OBJECT_EXIST: the “{{name}}” equipment has the same digital signature, it is already included in your objects.
GENERIC_ERROR: An error has occurred while creating the object on the server
CHANGE_ACCESS_POINT_WIFI:
1. Make sure the router used by the devices is disconnected.

2. Check that the devices are flashing.

3. Start up your new router, to which the devices will be connected.
WIFI_NAME_LABEL:
Select the Wi-Fi network of your Internet router to add an accessory.

Note:

- The WiFi network must be in 2.4Ghz mode. You may have to adjust your router to put your WiFi in 2.4Ghz mode.
STILL_LISTENING: The process is still ongoing; if all your devices are included in the list, or if you wish to stop the process, press the button below
WEATHER_OBJECT_CREATED: the “{{name}}” weather station has been added
SELECT_A_HEATER: Select from existing on/off heating systems
SELECT_THERMOSTAT_DELAY_STEP: Inertia of heating elements in the main area
